title: Unbiased Evaluation of Large Language Models from a Causal Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the correlation between domain accuracy (e.g., across MMLU subjects) and a proposed Consensus-Error Rate metric within an Agents-as-an-Evaluator probing task to identify if models favor domains where they already perform well.

Measuring Over-Confidence Rate and Under-Confidence Rate against a collective consensus across varying degrees of question rephrasing to detect if LLMs generate and favor content that aligns with their implicit strengths.
